records.author: Sap, Gabriel, Qin, Jurafsky, Smith and Choi
limitations: Dataset is a social-bias research corpus; acronym overlap with Japanese SBIC East Japan does not establish an organizational relationship.

records.title: Can LLMs Transform Computational Social Science?
records.author: Ziems et al.

findings.task: zero-shot generation of implied social-bias statements for Social Bias Inference (SBIC)
findings.metric: proportion of pairwise rankings where two author-annotators unanimously preferred model generation over a gold human explanation
findings.annotator_method: two authors served as blind annotators; unanimous vote required

limitations: The 65.9% and 60.6% values are preference rates, not accuracy, not a general ChatGPT score, and not a financial prediction metric.

records.title: Your ASK Wallet, Now Powered by Coinbase

findings.relationship: Permission moved ASK wallet infrastructure to Coinbase Embedded Wallet
findings.key_custody: Coinbase secures the private key on the user's behalf under user authorization
